Delivered the complete independent ACVC clustered fixed-recipe C01 scientific review r2 for the fixed task at 9e4aca34b8336875ccc7e18915c4c2498bd7f738:

https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code/blob/9a655b28b5ac33935f88954c32b7a06b84c3252e/docs/research/candidates/acvc/pro_packets/20260914_cluster_fixed_recipe_c01_scientific_review_r2/archive/RESPONSE.md

The review identifies no material empirical, inferential or reporting defect in the inspected evidence and supports the frozen JOINT_ABOVE_MEI only at its provisional, iid-normal-model-dependent single-task ceiling. It preserves six equally weighted fit-panel units, shared-F dependence, adverse nested panels, absolute controls, development history and unknown support costs. It favors report consolidation while assessing the concrete new 1024/4096-exposure alternative and the outcomes that could change fixed-F development value; neither empirical repair nor a successor invocation is selected.

The response preserves the task's exact per-path commits: a94e4ae95bb8c558cf8d18e0d62f0f906ce9393a for scientific records, 6e8d1b8946e1b2eb0e4207cbc9cc9d006ad2abda for source, 902df04e46a4cea8fe788baed14ca8c447cf18ea for the Portfolio decision, and bbf9a0ee1908046960dd57751a202fec3275a166 for methods. Full file readback and commit comparison confirm that 9a655b28b5ac33935f88954c32b7a06b84c3252e adds only the specified response file. No source, card, earlier response, main, scientific state or slot was changed; no code execution, experiment or outcome reanalysis occurred. DM owns ordinary science and findings responses; Portfolio retains final direction lifecycle.
